tested_hypothesis.description: Put count before marker in the typed Header assignments so source dependency order would retain 0xFF through memset argument setup and select r8.
tested_hypothesis.result: The count store moved to the retail position, but GC/1.3 selected r5 for 0xFF and stored marker before loading memset size into r5; a comma-expression dependency scored 96.349594. Both regressions were discarded and the 99.861786% reconstruction was restored.
